description: This file defines the class CompatTabEclair, a specific implementation of the CompatTab interface used for creating and managing tab elements in an Android application, including setting text, icon, fragment, and listener.

classes.name: CompatTabEclair
classes.description: A subclass of CompatTab tailored for Android Eclair, providing methods to set and retrieve tab properties such as text, icon, fragment, and callback.

methods.name: CompatTabEclair(FragmentActivity activity, String tag)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tab with the given activity context and tag.

methods.name: setText(int resId)
methods.description: Sets the tab's text using a string resource ID.

methods.name: setIcon(int resId)
methods.description: Sets the tab's icon drawable using a resource ID.

methods.name: setTabListener(CompatTabListener callback)
methods.description: Assigns a callback listener for tab events.

methods.name: setFragment(Fragment fragment)
methods.description: Associates a fragment with the tab.

methods.name: getFragment()
methods.description: Returns the fragment associated with this tab.

methods.name: getText()
methods.description: Returns the text label of the tab.

methods.name: getIcon()
methods.description: Returns the icon drawable of the tab.

methods.name: getTab()
methods.description: Returns the tab object; currently returns null.

methods.name: getCallback()
methods.description: Returns the callback listener assigned to the tab.
